title: Gouache Tips in International Artist
content: If you've been experimenting with gouache, you'll want to pick up the brand new issue ofInternational Artist Magazine(#105 Oct/Nov).I chose my top ten tips for success and illustrated them with 10 examples, and included QR codes so that you can use your phone to go behind the scenes of the paintings and watch them being made on video.--------I'm on Instagram. Check me out@jamesgurneyart
